description: This file defines the implementation of the 'Number' class within the CalcEngine namespace, including constructors, conversion to PNUMBER, and utility methods like Sign, Exp, Mantissa, and IsZero.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a numeric value with sign, exponent, and mantissa, providing methods for conversion and utility checks.

methods.name: Number()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the number to 1 with zero exponent and mantissa.

methods.name: Number(int32_t sign, int32_t exp, vector<uint32_t> const& mantissa)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing the number with specified sign, exponent, and mantissa.

methods.name: Number(PNUMBER p)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Number object from a PNUMBER pointer.

methods.name: ToPNUMBER()
methods.description: Converts the Number object to a PNUMBER structure.

methods.name: Sign()
methods.description: Returns the sign of the number.

methods.name: Exp()
methods.description: Returns the exponent of the number.

methods.name: Mantissa()
methods.description: Returns the mantissa vector of the number.

methods.name: IsZero()
methods.description: Checks if the number is zero based on its mantissa.
